THE SPLIT OUTRAN THE EXCLUSION, and it is why main went red on 2026-09-06. capture-core.mjs was excluded because it drives NVDA. On 2026-09-05 it was split into three, and the exclusion followed only the PARENT - so 4,823 statements of guidepup-driving code entered the measured population at 0%, and packages/ fell from 87.18% to 77.64%. Nothing in the split was wrong and no test was deleted.

THAT IS THIS REPOSITORY'S MOST EXPENSIVE RECURRING SHAPE, arriving in its own coverage config: a remedy applied at one call site when the behaviour reaches several - the defect capture-core.mjs's own header catalogues four times. WHEN A FILE IN THIS LIST IS SPLIT, EVERY CHILD INHERITS ITS REASON OR EARNS AN EXPLICIT ONE.

A COVERAGE THRESHOLD IS A SHARED BUDGET. One untestable file spends everyone's, and the cost lands on whoever pushes next - here, on a main that six PRs were queued behind. The floor is not lowered to fit a file; the file is either made testable, or excluded with its reason stated here.

day it lands. #1320 (step 4 of the rstest adoption, #1317) moved `npm run coverage` onto

RE-DERIVED AGAIN BY THE SAME METHOD, 2026-10-07 (#3993), because the POPULATION changed, not because a number was lowered to fit. The packages left (lab, control, agent-org, and nvda-worker/worker-fleet as laid `src/` with their tests in their own repositories), and 73/72 was a reading of a tree that held their tests. Measured at e31b5ec69 plus #3991, `pnpm run coverage` in a fresh worktree: 33.11% lines / 33.38% statements over 12,717 lines, of which 4,094 + 1,618 statements were the two laid layers above (0% and 2.3%). With those two excluded: lines 4,179/8,041 = 51.97%, statements 5,239/10,090 = 51.92% -> 51/51. The fresh-worktree reading was not the cause: the unfolded child coverage (10 files, 9 statements) and the `[eval1]` ENOENT are worth under 0.1 point, and the child-process fold adds 1.1.

WHAT THE 51 IS MADE OF, SO IT IS RAISED RATHER THAN ADMIRED: 110 of the files still measured here (root `scripts/*.mjs`, `packages/guards/src/*.mjs`) read 0% because the tests that exercised them left with the packages (`TEST_GLOB` in scripts/coverage.mjs finds 140 files, none beside those). Raise these numbers as tests land for them; never lower them.
